name: @experiment-kit/workspace
description: Explorable Models: an inspectable, reproducible interactive explanation toolkit for developers and agents.

scripts.build: node scripts/revisions.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:sdk && npm run build --workspace @experiment-kit/activity && npm run build --workspace @experiment-kit/catalog && npm run build --workspace @experiment-kit/player && npm run build --workspace @experiment-kit/player-3d && npm run build --workspace @experiment-kit/agent && node scripts/generate-api.mjs
scripts.release:preview: npm run verify:preview && node scripts/package-preview.mjs && npm run verify:artifacts
scripts.test:cross-browser: EXPERIMENT_KIT_CROSS_BROWSER=1 playwright test composition.spec.ts embedding-renderer.spec.ts study-quadratic.spec.ts study-function-derivative.spec.ts study-linear-transformation.spec.ts study-lifecycle.spec.ts study-projection.spec.ts study-interaction.spec.ts study-presentation.spec.ts study-observed-data.spec.ts study-spatial.spec.ts study-spatial-framing.spec.ts
scripts.test:contracts: node scripts/study-harness/generate-contracts.mjs --check && vitest run tests/activity/contracts.test.ts tests/activity/contracts-semantics.test.ts tests/activity/versions.test.ts tests/activity/boundaries.test.ts tests/activity/rust-agreement.test.ts && cargo test --manifest-path packages/activity/rust/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:disclosure: vitest run tests/activity/disclosure.test.ts tests/activity/exposure.test.ts tests/activity/projection.test.ts tests/activity/independence.test.ts tests/activity/all-templates.test.ts tests/activity/text-safety.test.ts tests/agent/activity-tools.test.ts tests/player-activity/all-templates.test.ts tests/player-activity/ssr-render.test.ts
scripts.test:migrations: vitest run tests/activity/migrations.test.ts tests/activity/artifacts.test.ts tests/activity/host-failures.test.ts tests/activity/portable-backup.test.ts tests/activity/restore.test.ts tests/activity/deletion.test.ts
scripts.test:lifecycle: vitest run tests/core/interaction.test.ts tests/player-3d/controller.test.ts tests/player-3d/limits.test.ts && playwright test study-lifecycle.spec.ts
